modmenu.descriptionTranslation.glintsmit: Customize enchantment glints and item outlines for every item from every mod, and fix the gaps in item models.
glintsmith.title: Glintsmith
glintsmith.save_failed: Glintsmith could not save its settings
glintsmith.button.reset_tab.tooltip: Reset every setting on the current tab to its default. Nothing is saved until you press Done.
glintsmith.button.open_config.tooltip: Open glintsmith.json in your default editor. Changes made there are picked up automatically.
glintsmith.button.open_textures.tooltip: Open the folder for your own glint textures (PNG files).
glintsmith.confirm.discard.title: Discard changes?
glintsmith.confirm.discard.message: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving them?
glintsmith.confirm.discard.rule: You have unsaved changes to this rule. Leave without keeping them?
glintsmith.confirm.reset.title: Reset tab?
glintsmith.confirm.reset.message: Reset all settings on the "%s" tab to their defaults?
glintsmith.common.inherit.tooltip:
Inherit: use the value from the global settings or from earlier rules.
Custom: this rule sets its own value.
glintsmith.outline.heading: Item outlines
glintsmith.outline.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for all item outlines.
glintsmith.outline.only_local_player.too: Only outline items held or worn by you. Other players' items are left alone.
glintsmith.outline.condition.tooltip: Which items get an outline before your rules are applied.
glintsmith.outline.condition.enchanted.t: Items with enchantments or the vanilla glint.
glintsmith.outline.condition.none.toolti: No item gets an outline unless one of your rules switches it on.
glintsmith.outline.target.third_person.t: Items held by players and mobs, including you in third person view.
glintsmith.outline.target.dropped.toolti: Item entities lying on the ground.
glintsmith.outline.target.gui.tooltip: Items in inventories, the hotbar and other menus. Off by default because it can be busy.
glintsmith.outline.target.other.tooltip: Items worn on the head or drawn in other places that are not listed here.
glintsmith.outline.color.tooltip: Color of the outline. Can be static, animated or taken from the item's enchantments.
glintsmith.outline.thickness.tooltip: Width of the outline in screen pixels.
glintsmith.outline.softness.tooltip: How soft the outer edge is. 0 % is a sharp edge.
glintsmith.outline.fade_start.tooltip: Outlines in the world start to fade out at this distance. 0 together with a fade end of 0 means no distance fade.
glintsmith.outline.fade_end.tooltip: Outlines in the world are completely gone at this distance. 0 means no distance fade. If it is not larger than the fade start, it is corrected when you save.
glintsmith.outline.scale_with_resolution: The thickness grows with the window size, measured at a window height of 1080 pixels. Off keeps the thickness in real screen pixels.
glintsmith.outline.shaders.tooltip: Do not draw outlines while a shader pack is active. Useful if your shader pack already renders them differently.
glintsmith.outline.hand_with_shader_pack: Keep first-person outlines while an Iris shader pack is active. Best effort: it may not work with every shader pack.
glintsmith.outline.iris_active: A shader pack is active: world outlines are off. Hand outlines are best effort, GUI outlines work.
glintsmith.outline.durability.enabled.to: Pulse the outline towards the alert color when an item is nearly broken.
The alert shows when the remaining durability is at or below this value.
glintsmith.outline.durability.color.tool: Color of the alert. Type a hex color like #FF2A2A or open the color picker.
glintsmith.glint.heading: Enchantment glint
glintsmith.glint.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. Off leaves every glint exactly as in vanilla.
glintsmith.glint.category.tooltip: The glint is drawn in four layers that you can set up separately. Choose which one you are editing below.
glintsmith.glint.category.item.tooltip: Items held in hand, dropped, or in item frames.
glintsmith.glint.category.armor.tooltip: Armor worn by players and mobs.
glintsmith.glint.category.entity.tooltip: Entity glints such as enchanted items carried by mobs and other entity models.
glintsmith.glint.layer_enabled.tooltip: Off hides the glint of this layer completely.
glintsmith.glint.texture.tooltip: The glint texture. vanilla or empty: the vanilla texture. preset:<name>: a built-in texture such as preset:rainbow. file:<name>.png: a PNG from your textures folder. namespace:path: a texture from a resource pack. Red text means the name is not valid.
glintsmith.glint.texture.previous.toolti: Previous texture: cycles through vanilla, the presets and your PNG files from the textures folder.
glintsmith.glint.texture.next.tooltip: Next texture: cycles through vanilla, the presets and your PNG files from the textures folder.
glintsmith.glint.tint.tooltip: Multiply a color onto the glint. Off keeps the texture's own colors.
glintsmith.glint.tint_color.tooltip: The tint. Can be static, animated or taken from the item's enchantments.
glintsmith.glint.speed.tooltip: How fast the glint moves. 1.00 is vanilla, 0 freezes it.
glintsmith.glint.scale.tooltip: Size of the glint pattern. 1.00 is vanilla; larger values stretch it. In packs with a very large texture atlas, lower it to see the pattern.
glintsmith.glint.strength.tooltip: How visible the glint is. 100 % is vanilla.
glintsmith.glint.rotation.tooltip: Angle of the glint pattern in degrees. 10 is vanilla.
glintsmith.glint.help: Put PNG files with lower case names in the textures folder, then pick them with the arrow buttons or type file:<name>.png
glintsmith.modelfix.heading: Glint gap fix
glintsmith.modelfix.enabled.tooltip: Close the thin gaps and seams the vanilla glint leaves on some flat item models.
glintsmith.modelfix.mode.tooltip: Automatic uses fixed values for your operating system and turns itself off when Model Fix is installed. Custom uses the values below as they are.
glintsmith.modelfix.mode.auto.tooltip: Picks fixed values for your operating system, and turns itself off when the Model Fix mod is installed. Recommended.
glintsmith.modelfix.mode.custom.tooltip: Use the values below for every model.
glintsmith.modelfix.uv_shrink.tooltip: Multiplier for how far the texture coordinates of the item sides are pulled in. 0 changes nothing.
glintsmith.modelfix.side_expansion.toolt: Grows (positive) or shrinks (negative) the side faces of the item, in model units.
glintsmith.modelfix.side_indent.tooltip: Moves the side faces inwards (positive) or outwards (negative), in model units.
glintsmith.modelfix.precise_spans.toolti: Warning: builds the item sides from more, smaller faces. This is exact but creates many more quads on HD textures and can cost performance.
glintsmith.modelfix.help.rebuild: Changes rebuild item models automatically when you press Done.
glintsmith.modelfix.help.custom: The sliders are only used in custom mode.
glintsmith.rules.heading: Rules
glintsmith.rules.add.tooltip: Create a new rule and edit it.
glintsmith.rules.add_held.tooltip: Create a rule for the item in your main hand. Needs a world and an item in your hand.
glintsmith.rules.empty: No rules yet. Add one above.
glintsmith.rules.enabled.tooltip: Switch this rule on or off.
glintsmith.rules.up.tooltip: Move up (earlier, overridden by later rules).
glintsmith.rules.invalid: This rule is invalid and does nothing until fixed: %s
glintsmith.enchantments.help: Colors used by the "enchantment colors" mode. Leave a box empty to use the default.
glintsmith.enchantments.search.tooltip: Filter the list by name or id.
glintsmith.enchantments.color.tooltip: Hex color for this enchantment, for example #FF3B3B. Empty uses the default.
glintsmith.enchantments.reset.tooltip: Go back to the default color of this enchantment.
glintsmith.rule.title: Edit rule
glintsmith.rule.name: Name
glintsmith.rule.name.tooltip: A name for your own reference. It has no effect.
glintsmith.rule.enabled.tooltip: Switch this rule on or off.
glintsmith.rule.condition.tooltip: Whether the item has to be enchanted.
glintsmith.rule.condition.enchanted.tool: Only matches items with enchantments or a glint.
glintsmith.rule.items.tooltip: Items this rule applies to. Empty matches every item.
glintsmith.rule.exclude.tooltip: Items this rule never applies to, even if they match above.
glintsmith.rule.enchantments.tooltip: The rule only applies if the item has one of these enchantments. Empty means no condition.
glintsmith.rule.syntax:
Separate entries with commas.
minecraft:diamond_sword - one exact id
#minecraft:swords - a tag
@modid - everything from one mod
*_sword, mymod:* - wildcards (* any text, ? one character)
!pattern - negation, matches everything except the pattern
Without a namespace, minecraft: is assumed.
glintsmith.rule.patterns.help: Hover a box for the pattern syntax. Invalid entries turn red; a rule with an invalid entry does nothing.
glintsmith.rule.target.third_person.tool: Apply to items held by players and mobs.
glintsmith.rule.target.dropped.tooltip: Apply to items on the ground.
glintsmith.rule.target.item_frame.toolti: Apply to items in item frames.
glintsmith.rule.target.gui.tooltip: Apply to items in inventories and menus.
glintsmith.rule.outline.override.tooltip: Let this rule change the outline of the items it matches. Every setting below can still be left on Inherit.
glintsmith.rule.outline.enabled.tooltip: Force the outline on or off for matching items, or inherit.
glintsmith.rule.outline.softness.tooltip: How soft the outer edge is.
glintsmith.rule.glint.override.tooltip: Let this rule change the glint of the items it matches. Every setting below can still be left on Inherit.
glintsmith.rule.glint.enabled.tooltip: Force the glint on or off for matching items, or inherit.
glintsmith.rule.glint.speed.tooltip: How fast the glint moves. 1.00 is vanilla.
glintsmith.rule.glint.scale.tooltip: Size of the glint pattern. 1.00 is vanilla. In packs with a very large texture atlas, lower it to see the pattern.
glintsmith.rule.glint.rotation.tooltip: Angle of the glint pattern in degrees. 10 is vanilla.
glintsmith.color.title: Color style
glintsmith.color.mode.tooltip: How the color is produced over time.
glintsmith.color.mode.rainbow.tooltip: Cycles through all hues of the rainbow.
glintsmith.color.mode.pulse.tooltip: With one color its brightness pulses. With two or more it fades back and forth between the first two.
glintsmith.color.mode.gradient.tooltip: Fades smoothly through all colors in order and loops back to the first.
glintsmith.color.mode.enchantment.toolti: Fades through the colors of the enchantments on the item. You can change those colors on the Enchantments tab.
glintsmith.color.help.rainbow: Uses speed, saturation and brightness. The colors list is not used.
glintsmith.color.help.pulse: One color pulses in brightness; two or more fade between the first two.
glintsmith.color.help.gradient: Fades through all colors in order. The preview shows the last few seconds.
glintsmith.color.help.enchantment: Uses the colors of the item's enchantments. The preview shows sharpness, unbreaking and mending.
glintsmith.color.hex.tooltip: Hex color: #RRGGBB (or #AARRGGBB with transparency). Red text means it is not valid.
glintsmith.color.speed.tooltip: How fast the color changes. 0 freezes it.
glintsmith.color.saturation.tooltip: Color intensity of the rainbow. Only used in rainbow mode.
glintsmith.color.brightness.tooltip: Brightness of the rainbow. Only used in rainbow mode.
glintsmith.picker.title: Pick a color
glintsmith.picker.hue.tooltip: The base color on the color wheel.
glintsmith.picker.saturation.tooltip: From grey to the full color.
glintsmith.picker.brightness.tooltip: From black to the full color.
glintsmith.picker.hex.tooltip: Hex color: #RRGGBB. Changes here update the sliders.
glintsmith.picker.revert.tooltip: Go back to the color you started with.
